arguments.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
FROM transactions t
JOIN cards c ON t.card_id = c.id
JOIN users u ON c.user_id = u.id
JOIN merchants m ON t.merchant_id = m.id
JOIN merchant_locations ml ON t.merchant_location_id = ml.id
WHERE u.gender = 'Female'
  AND m.mcc = 5812
  AND ml.state = 'TX'
arguments.explanation: Counts all transactions made by female users at MCC 5812 merchants whose location is in Texas.
assumptions: Female users are identified by users.gender = 'Female', reached through cards.user_id.
MCC 5812 is matched on merchants.mcc, and the location is the transaction's merchant_location_id.
The count includes all transactions, labelled or unlabelled; no fraud filter is applied.
Covers the full data range, 2019-01-01 to 2019-10-31.
